name: nds_sound
statement: The ARM7's sixteen sound channels (0x04000400 + 16 n: SOUNDxCNT, SOUNDxSAD, SOUNDxTMR, SOUNDxPNT, SOUNDxLEN) mixed into stereo samples: PCM8, PCM16 and IMA-ADPCM from memory, PSG square waves (channels 8-13) and noise (14-15), each at its own timer rate, with volume, divider and panning, through SOUNDCNT's master volume and enable. A one-shot channel stops (its busy bit clears) when its samples run out, a looping one goes back to its loop start (ADPCM with the state it had there), and a one-shot capture stops when its buffer would be full.

registers.name: SOUNDxCNT
registers.bits: 0-6 volume, 8-9 divider (1, 2, 4, 16), 15 hold, 16-22 panning (0 left, 64 centre, 127 right), 24-26 PSG duty, 27-28 repeat (0 manual, 1 loop, 2 one-shot), 29-30 format (0 PCM8, 1 PCM16, 2 IMA-ADPCM, 3 PSG/noise), 31 start/busy

registers.name: SOUNDxTMR (sample period: 0x10000 - TMR ticks of 16.756991 MHz)
SOUNDxLEN (length after the loop start, words)
SNDCAP0CNT, SNDCAP1CNT (bit 2 one-shot, bit 3 PCM8, bit 7 start/busy)

adpcm.header: the first word: bits 0-15 the initial sample, bits 16-22 the initial step index
adpcm.nibble: diff = step/8 + step/4 (bit 0) + step/2 (bit 1) + step (bit 2); bit 3 subtracts; the index moves by index_table[n & 7] within 0..88; low nibble first

psg: 8 steps per period, high for duty + 1 of them (duty 7: always low)
noise: a 15-bit LFSR from 0x7FFF: when bit 0 is set, x = (x >> 1) ^ 0x6000 and the output is low, else x = x >> 1 and high
limits: nearest-sample playback (no interpolation), mixed in 16 bits with a quarter headroom; the capture units do not write memory (their busy bits only), the hold bit and SOUNDBIAS change nothing
sources: GBATEK (DS sound: channels, formats, ADPCM, PSG and noise, mixer)
